comment: DVB-RCS2 Network Clock Reference as carried in GSE (protocol type 0x0081):
a 33-bit base (90 kHz) and a 9-bit extension (27 MHz); NCR = 300 base + extension, the NCR of the first symbol of
the SOF of the DVB-S2 PL frame two before the one that carries it.
plan/builder/dvbrcs2/forward fits the forward link's NCR clock of them
